patch_description: This crossover combines the current program’s compact multi-start strategy with the inspiration program’s stronger squared-distance formulation, exact analytic Jacobian, unequal-radius initialization, staggered hexagonal row families, and final feasibility repair. Squared separation constraints avoid repeated square roots during optimization, while analytic derivatives make SLSQP substantially more reliable than finite-difference constraints. The constructor explores several five- and six-row boundary patterns, then spends additional iterations only polishing the strongest candidates. A final uniform radius scaling guarantees containment and non-overlap despite numerical tolerance at active contacts.
